title.value: AN ACT concerning Environment - Playground Surfacing Materials - Prohibitions

pfas_definition.provenance: PFAS MEANS PER- AND POLYFLUOROALKYL SUBSTANCES.

type.provenance: A PERSON MAY NOT USE, SUPPLY, SELL, SOLICIT, OR OFFER FOR SALE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS THAT CONTAIN...

exceptions: playground surfacing materials that contain PAH, PFAS, or lead that are more stringent than the requirements of this subtitle
